characters.name: 贵叔
characters.design: Uncle Gui, 59-year-old dark-skinned rice farmer with deep facial wrinkles, old army-green raincoat slung over his shoulders, rolled-up trouser legs stepping in muddy field, straw hat strap tight under his chin, worn rubber shoes covered in mud, realistic rural documentary style, suggested full-body front view showing laboring state

characters.name: 秋禾
characters.design: Qiuhe, 26-year-old returning daughter with ponytail, old baseball cap, long-sleeve shirt rolled to elbows, labor insurance gloves holding rice bundles, natural tanned skin, simple and capable image, realistic rural documentary style, suggested full-body side view showing rice bundling action

props.name: 旧军绿雨衣
props.design: Worn old army-green raincoat, slightly faded cotton fabric with mud stains at the hem, casually draped over shoulder, realistic worn texture, muted earthy tone, suggested half-body view showing its used state in field

issues: 设计要点要求雨衣'casually draped over shoulder'（随意搭于肩上），画面中雨衣为正常穿着状态；设计要点要求'slightly faded cotton fabric'（略微褪色棉质面料），画面中雨衣材质呈现为防水合成材料（非棉质）

props.name: 稻捆
props.design: Tightly bundled ripe golden rice stalks, plump full rice ears tied with straw rope, natural golden grain texture with earthy brown stalk color, heavy and full appearance, suggested close-up view showing the rich rice grains

scenes.name: 南方抢收稻田
scenes.design: Vast southern rice paddy with plump golden rice ears swaying in wind, low-hanging dark storm clouds, muddy field ridges, distant mountains shrouded in rain mist, sparrows flying across the field, diffused pre-storm overcast light with faint warm golden rim on rice ears, cool blue-gray cast on sky and mountains, realistic rural documentary style, suggested wide environmental view

scenes.name: 标准储粮仓
scenes.design: Standardized sealed grain barn with rustic wooden structure, golden rice grains pouring into the barn interior, simple practical rural storage facility, natural earthy tones, suggested medium shot showing the grain pouring action beside the barn

issues: 设计要点要求'standardized sealed grain barn'（标准密封粮仓），画面中谷仓门敞开呈开放式状态，非密封结构；设计要点要求稻谷'pouring into the barn interior'（倒入谷仓内部），画面中稻谷从谷仓门口倾泻而出
